doctrine: The glyph-calculus carrier this estate pins: five Greek letters, alpha to
epsilon, each fixed to an exact codepoint.
Point `verify-glyph-reply --carrier` at this file and the run becomes a
verification: the host brought the allowlist, and a packet declaring any
other carrier is refused with FW-CARRIER-MISMATCH rather than checked
against its own. Without it the run can establish consistency and says so,
The codepoints are pinned, not the glyphs. U+237A APL FUNCTIONAL SYMBOL
ALPHA renders identically to U+03B1 on the page and is a different
character; it does not NFKC-fold to alpha either, so only an allowlist
catches it. That substitution is the one that motivated this module.
